sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Downsides next: caffeine tradeoffs are real. Sleep disruption, jitters, and overuse risk stop this from being a clean automatic S. Habit dependence can creep in. A stronger practical downside than green tea usually carries. People often ruin it with sugary add-ins. The practical version consumed is not always the clean black-coffee version.
